snippet.title: Spray N Pray GD74/PG26
snippet.description:
Spray & Pray is a First-Person, Fast-Paced Movement Boomer Shooter, 
where players take control of a priest called Justinian whom the gods anointed, 
to kill demons and the fallen angels plaguing the earth and earn his righteous place in heaven. 
Players must use the priest's movement capabilities to quickly run, dash, 
and jump around the world while using his arsenal of unique guns in tandem
with unique utilities to clear his path through the church to the fallen angel.
